fps.measurement: PC monotonic elapsed seconds and completed-frame counters during one normal run per version.
fps.scope: One normal physical H1 run per version with Axe and the same opening/30-second diagonal movement/later-standing key sequence. PC monotonic time and completed frame counters; 20Hz game limit. Full roster and initial random seed were not controlled, so small differences cannot establish a causal speedup. Not a whole-match or every-scene guarantee. Original scalar LUT baseline versus final guarded exact MXU and ground cache, including new game logic; no in-RAM backend flag manipulation. Remote-purchase actions occur only after all FPS windows.

reuse_rule: Historical results may be reused for a new standalone build only after the exact BDA SHA-256 and runtime asset identities match. A build/CI pass is not a new physical H1 or emulator test. The small A/B FPS difference does not prove causal speedup.
